poses: idle, look, stretch, blink (cells 1–3 of the 3 × 2 sheet; blink = idle with the eyes painted shut by Claude Code: the sheet drew its tilt pose with the perch lower, so the post jumped)
prompt:
Pixel art sprite sheet of Hedwig, Harry Potter's snowy owl, arranged in a 3x2 grid (3 columns by 2 rows) on a solid white background, matching the chunky pixel art style, dark #231F2E pixel outline, top-left lighting, and proportions of the reference images.

Book-accurate Hedwig: cute chibi proportions with a large round head, large amber-gold eyes, small dark beak, and pure snow-white plumage with only a few subtle dark flecks on the wings (pure white body, not grey or blue).

Perch consistency (CRITICAL):
She perches on an upright rustic carved wooden T-shaped perch post. The post, its height, its width, and the cream parchment letter with red wax seal hanging by a string from the right perch arm are 100% IDENTICAL and at the exact same position in all 6 poses. The bottom of the vertical wooden post aligns to a single strict horizontal baseline across row 1, and a single strict horizontal baseline across row 2 (in pose 5 'spread', the vertical post must NOT be cut short, it must have the full vertical post down to the row baseline). The hanging letter is identical in shape, size, and orientation across all poses.

Sheet layout:
3x2 grid, three-quarter view toward lower-left, same size in every pose, wide empty gaps between cells, plain solid white background, no text, no shadows, no grid lines.

Poses (only Hedwig moves):
Row 1:
1. idle: Hedwig perched upright on the wooden T-perch, looking forward with bright amber-gold eyes, wings folded.
2. look: Head turned gently to the screen-left, wings folded.
3. stretch: Eyes happily closed, one wing stretched out a little.
Row 2:
4. tilt: Head tilted to the screen-right, curious amber eyes, wings folded.
5. spread: Both wings spread wide open ready to take flight, perched on the full-length wooden post.
6. letter: Holding the letter in her beak.
